and we have made signifi cant progress against our Key Strategic Objectives outlined in our “Go for Gold” 2016 – 2020 Strategy.

successfully went live.
• Launch of various digital portals to better serve our customers and partners for example FA Portal, Customer Portal and
Marine Portal.
